newsitem.title: USA: New subscribers help Data Transmission Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: New subscribers help Data Transmission Q1 results.

text.p: Data Transmission Network Corp said Monday a surge in new subscribers helped the company post a profit in the first quarter ended March 31.

The company said net income reached $361,600, or $0.03 a share, compared to a loss of $357,000, or $0.04, a year ago. The per share figures have been adjusted to reflect a three-for-one stock split in mid-1996, Data Transmission said.
Revenues climbed to $29.5 million from $19.1 million in the same period in 1996, the company said.

Data Transmission said the increase in revenues stemmed from a 52-percent rise in total subscribers to 151,800 versus 99,600 last year. The company also cited a decline in selling, general and administrative expenses for the earnings improvement.
Data Transmission is an information and communications services company.
Its shares were up 1-1/2 Monday at 25-1/8.
